dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Are you injured at all? Rest here, let me give you a full examination.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: Just a scratch? Ooh, you shouldn't say that! No matter how minor your injury, you mustn't ignore it.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: I won't take up too much of your time, I promise!

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: I don't like it when people around me get hurt. It's so upsetting to see them in pain...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: But sometimes in life, fighting is inevitable. All I can do is pray, and support everyone from behind by patching up the injured...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: And I have to do it with a smile, if only to keep people's spirits up.

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: A squirrel, a fox, and a cute kitty-cat...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: I'm trying to write a heartwarming song with a fairytale theme, but it's a little tough...

dialogues.speaker: Barbara
dialogues.text: I think I need to go back to the story books and look for some more inspiration!
